one_line: Five committed UNWTO CSVs (domestic, inbound, outbound, tourism industries, SDG tourism indicators), global country coverage, 1995-2022, MIT, built as a SQL medallion warehouse.
abnb_use: A genuinely global, 27-year UNWTO arrivals/receipts panel we do not currently hold in this shape -- fills gap #7's need for LatAm/APAC regional travel-volume context beyond the EU-only Eurostat series.
sample_plan: Pull the Datasets/ folder CSVs directly (inbound tourism, outbound tourism, tourism industries) for the last ~10 years; cap at 5MB, skip the SQL scripts.
